displayDescription: A dithered light grows into an idea bulb, then a moving threshold boundary switches the right panel into a connected system.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene: tones are approximated with an 8x8 ordered Bayer threshold on a 320x180 one-bit buffer scaled 4x nearest-neighbour; no physical lighting or print simulation.

Exactly two pre-encode values (#142536 ink, #EDF1F3 paper) from the catalogue swatches; the accent #005885 and secondary #B9D5DE are not used because a third value would break the one-bit rule. The illustration's navy/yellow pair was treated as a composition reference only.

STYLE.json lists no reviewed preview recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action (density growth into a shape, then a moving threshold boundary switching a second region).
Lettering is an original 5x7 bitmap font built on the same pixel grid with solid backings; video compression may add intermediate colours after export.
Blender was not used, per instruction.
